why: apicontract metrics A5-A7 (.sdlc/intents/apicontract/metrics.md), the arm without the tool. An agent given only a raw OpenAPI file must call one operation exactly as the contract says: method, path, nested body and a unit conversion (metres to decimetres). The fixture API is synthetic so no model knows it from training. A wrong method, a flattened body or an invented field fails the check; the same case run later with `apicontract explain` is the arm with the tool.
